CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

2. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   C. Damage equipment used for Football.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.

   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

6. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)

   D. Damage equipment used for Rounders.

7. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

12. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.

13. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

14. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
